channel.title: The Oracle Gazette
channel.description: AI, robotics and jobs in plain English.

item.title: Saturday, November 28, 2026 — Canada expands AI computing fund to $1 billion
item.description: On November 26, Ottawa announced a $700 million expansion of its AI Compute Access Fund. Eligible small and medium-sized businesses can receive support covering up to 80% of eligible computing costs when using a sovereign Canadian provider, compared with up to 50% for other eligible cloud services.

item.title: Thursday, November 26, 2026 — Canada prepares a new AI computing announcement
item.description: Canada's federal government said on November 25 that AI Minister Evan Solomon will announce measures in Toronto today at 10:15 a.m. Eastern time to help domestic companies develop and expand AI. Details had not been released at the time of this edition.

item.title: Tuesday, November 24, 2026 — Robots are learning when to ask for help
item.description: Researchers at the Technical University of Munich announced an AI model on November 23 that helps robots identify tasks beyond their abilities. Instead of pressing ahead when uncertain, a robot can stop and seek human assistance. The work is a research advance, not proof that robots are ready for every workplace.

item.title: Thursday, November 19, 2026 — Carney calls for global rules on artificial intelligence
item.description: Speaking at the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China, Prime Minister Mark Carney said having no worldwide rules for AI is an enormous risk and that it is past time to create them. He said he discussed the idea with Chinese President Xi Jinping, and that leaders of the top AI labs share his concerns.
